altitude.quote: Yangbajing (4300m above sea level, 90.53 deg E,30.11 deg N)

coordinates.locator: ARGO-YBJ "Experimental set-up" page (the "0" after 30 and 90 is the page's superscript degree sign); Tibet AS-gamma experiment page
coordinates.note: ARGO-YBJ's official page gives 30 deg 06' 38" N, 90 deg 31' 50" E (30.1106 N, 90.5306 E). The Tibet AS-gamma official page gives "90.53 deg E, 30.11 deg N" and a Tibet ASgamma paper gives 90.522 E, 30.102 N; the three agree to about 1 km, so one site record serves both experiments.
coordinates.quote: The site coordinates (latitude 300 06' 38'' N, longitude 900 31' 50'' E)

name: Yangbajing air-shower site (Tibet ASgamma and ARGO-YBJ)

summary.plain: A high plateau site 90 km north of Lhasa, 4300 metres up, where the Tibet AS-gamma scintillator array and the ARGO-YBJ resistive-plate detector watch cosmic-ray air showers.
summary.technical: Yangbajing in Tibet (30.11 N, 90.53 E, 4300 m a.s.l., 90 km north of Lhasa): site of the Tibet ASgamma scintillator/muon-detector array and the ARGO-YBJ full-coverage RPC carpet.
